_note: CVAT clips, full pipeline (baseline.env, --enable-team). Team: tools/team_eval.py vs data/cvat/*/teams.json; IDs: player IDF1 / switches.

variants.before: init 30, farthest-pair seeding, lr drift, lock after 8 votes, team veto in ID relink
variants.G: k-means seeding + refit every 200 samples + whole-life vote, veto on
variants.H: G without the team veto in ID relink

goalkeepers.method: team whose players centre is nearer (pitch coords), majority of last 150 frames, >= 45 votes (TEAM_GOALKEEPER)

day red GK.note: wrong frames at the start while players teams settle

goalkeepers.day black GK: only the last 45 frames, at the image edge: taken for an outfield player (role error), so no GK team
